Q-4184: Number of Days Between 2024-11-05 and 2024-12-10 (Inclusive End)

Answer: There are 35 days from 2024-11-05 to 2024-12-10 (excluding the start date 2024-11-05 but including the end date 2024-12-10).

Calculation: Inclusive end is counted, so the range is effectively 2024-11-06 to 2024-12-10. Total days = 30 (November) - 5 (start date) + 10 (December) = 35 days.

Source: Standard calendar calculation.
